kpis.label: Reference price
kpis.sub: Rs 155.78 = FY26 basic EPS Rs 5.64 x 27.62x, the median of the three listed peers the issuer names (pp. 154-156). It is an assumption, not a price band. The only priced issue, the Oct-2025 allotment against the promoters' businesses at Rs 33.63 after bonus and split (pp. 163, 388), was non-cash and is not used.

focus.title: Cash flow vs profit
focus.detail: CFO Rs 26.85 m in FY26 against PAT Rs 313.90 m (8.6%); cumulative CFO/PAT FY24-26 is 69.7% (281.93 / 404.39). FY26 absorbed a Rs 445.46 m inventory build (finished goods Rs 432.33 m vs Rs 19.26 m) and Rs 281.35 m other assets. Acquired balances came in through the slump sale, so the FY26 cash flow is not like-for-like with FY25.

focus.title: Related-party capex & subsidiaries
focus.detail: Capex of Rs 716.64 m is to be built on 16.20 acres leased from the promoter Jagatjit Singh at Rs 0.08 m a month (+15% every 3 years, to 2055). Related-party purchases FY26 Rs 164.91 m (6.5% of materials consumed) from Goodfield, Expert International, A.P.U Traders and G9 International, each owned by persons with KMP influence. Loans/advances to promoters Rs 55.00 m outstanding at 31-Mar-2026. No proceeds go to a subsidiary.

focus.title: Customer / supplier / geographic concentration
focus.detail: Demand side: Seth Agro Industries 25.21% of FY26 revenue (Rs 1,043.46 m; 17.20% FY25, 3.85% FY24); top 10 customers 50.04%; no long-term agreements. Supply side improved: top supplier 7.94% and top 10 40.53% of FY26 purchases (76.68% FY25). Geography: Northern 68.04% and Central 25.95% of FY26 revenue.

focus.title: CARO / audit trail
focus.detail: The parent's accounting software recorded an audit trail (edit log) only from January 2026; before that it had no such feature (Note 52(xxi)). Audit-trail-at-database-level is also flagged as a risk (p. 52). The Rule 11(g) requirement is therefore met for part of FY26 only.

focus.title: Monitoring agency
focus.detail: The company states it will appoint a monitoring agency before the RHP; issue size above Rs 500 m requires one. Not yet named.

focus.title: Eligibility re-computation
focus.detail: Offer is under Reg 6(2) because Reg 6(1)(a) (net tangible assets Rs 30 m in each of three years) and 6(1)(c) (net worth Rs 10 m in each year) are not met: FY24 net worth was Rs 5.32 m (p. 85). At least 75% must be allotted to QIBs or the offer fails.

focus.title: Lead-manager track record
focus.detail: Keynote Financial Services has two IPOs in FY2026-27 (Rs 5,858 m) and none in FY2024-26 per the DRHP; both traded below issue at day 30 (-23.53% and -2.75%). Short record; see Appendix B.

focus.title: Valuation model guard
focus.detail: AMBER: DCF and relative diverge by -43.0% - the divergence is the finding; name its cause

focus.title: Valuation model guard
focus.detail: AMBER: TV above 75% of EV - DCF is mostly a terminal guess

focus.title: Data gap (high)
focus.detail: Price band, offer price, final fresh/OFS share counts, offer expenses and general corporate purposes amount are all [●]; valuation uses a reference price

focus.title: Data gap (high)
focus.detail: Financials run to 31-Mar-2026 (not older than 6 months at the 25-Sep-2026 filing); no H1 FY27 data. Seasonal Q4 weakness and the peak-season order book cannot be read

focus.title: Data gap (high)
focus.detail: FY26 is the first year of the consolidated business (slump sale from 1-Apr-2025); FY25 and FY24 restated are the company-only base (Rs 959 m / Rs 489 m). Only the proforma P&L and balance sheet are comparable, and proforma cash flow is not given

focus.title: Data gap (medium)
focus.detail: Identity and relationship of the largest customer, Seth Agro Industries (25.21% of FY26 revenue), is not described; it is not listed as a related party

focus.title: Data gap (medium)
focus.detail: Receivable ageing and provision coverage for FY26 not extracted in full

comfort.title: Bonus issue / share-count consistency
comfort.detail: 22:1 bonus (allotted 27-May-2026) and 1:2 split (4-May-2026) are applied to every year: EPS 5.64 / 1.42 / 0.57 and NAV 12.75 use the 55,650,984-share count. FY26 EPS divides PAT by the year-end count rather than a time-weighted count (the 9.65 m consideration shares were issued 22-Oct-2025); a weighted count would give a higher EPS, so the reported P/E is not flattered.

comfort.title: Current vs deferred tax
comfort.detail: Current tax Rs 130.30 m on PBT Rs 444.12 m = 29.3% in FY26; cumulative FY24-26 current tax 147.09 / PBT 562.64 = 26.1%, above the 25.17% statutory rate. Deferred tax is negligible (credit Rs 0.09 m).

comfort.title: Revaluation reserve
comfort.detail: No revaluation reserve in the restated balance sheet.

comfort.title: Goodwill vs tangible equity
comfort.detail: Goodwill Rs 4.55 m = 0.6% of equity. The slump-sale businesses were taken in at carrying values (net assets Rs 320.03 m for consideration Rs 324.57 m; goodwill Rs 4.55 m). The proforma balance sheet shows goodwill of Rs 65.66 m (p. 91) against Rs 4.55 m in the restated one: the two treatments differ.

comfort.title: Contingent liabilities
comfort.detail: Contingent liabilities Rs 71.70 m (GST Rs 22.67 m, income tax Rs 0.18 m, other Rs 6.50 m, bank guarantees Rs 42.35 m) = 10.1% of net worth. Litigation: 8 tax proceedings and 1 regulatory matter against the company, Rs 27.71 m in aggregate; 2 criminal and 1 civil matter by the company, Rs 14.56 m.

comfort.title: Auditor qualifications / changes
comfort.detail: Anup Kumar Jain & Co (FRN 005731N); no qualification or emphasis of matter in the restated report. Auditor history: Singla Gupta resigned 23-Apr-2024 (preoccupation), Kansal Sandeep & Associates filled the vacancy 2-May-2024 and ceased 30-Sep-2024 (tenure), Anup Kumar Jain appointed 30-Sep-2024 (p. 98). FY24 and FY25 are special-purpose Ind AS statements; the earlier statutory auditor did not hold a peer-review certificate and did not perform the restatement (p. 343).

peers.name: Jagatjit Agri Engineering Limited at reference

overhang.label: Promoter minimum contribution (20% of post-offer capital); lock-in 18 months from allotment under ICDR, confirm in RHP; at Rs 155.78 reference
Promoter holding above the minimum, after the 31 lakh-share OFS (1 year from allotment under ICDR; confirm in RHP); at reference

strengths: Proforma revenue CAGR 41.3% over FY24-FY26; industry 10.2% over FY23-26 per the issuer-commissioned CARE report (pp. 92, 248)
ROCE 31.1% and interest cover 5.03x in FY26 (p. 158)
Cash tax 26.1% of cumulative PBT; no deferred-tax cushion (p. 87)
Top supplier 7.94% and top 10 suppliers 40.53% of FY26 purchases, down from 76.68% (p. 39)
20+ products and 192 SKUs; 233 dealers and 12 distributors across 20 states (pp. 246, 247)
weaknesses: Seth Agro Industries 25.21% of FY26 revenue (p. 261)
Northern states 68.04% and Central states 25.95% of revenue (p. 29)
Top three products 64.40% of FY26 revenue (p. 29)
FY26 CFO Rs 26.85 m vs PAT Rs 313.90 m (p. 88)
Audit trail in the accounting software only from Jan-2026 (p. 416)
opportunities: Indian farm equipment market Rs 1,397 bn FY26 to Rs 1,876 bn FY30, 7.7% CAGR, issuer-commissioned estimate (p. 250)
Dehlon expansion adds 29,000 units to 4,000, due Mar-2028 (pp. 137, 143)
Biomass briquette and pellet machines for crop-residue conversion (pp. 252, 253)
R&D team of 46 and three patents (p. 246)
threats: Demand depends on CRM and SMAM subsidies, with past delays in state payments (pp. 56, 57)
Q4 is a seasonally weak quarter (p. 34)
Group company Goodfield Technology has common pursuits with the issuer (p. 30)
Promoters were disqualified as directors from Sep-2020 to Oct-2021; compounding applications filed (p. 37)
Larger tractor OEMs (Escorts Kubota, VST, Indo Farm) are the only listed comparables (p. 156)

adjustments.item: Sundry creditor balances written back to other income
adjustments.reason: Other income of Rs 35.03 m includes Rs 26.05 m of sundry balances written back on closure of legacy creditors, 5.9% of PBT. It did not recur in FY25 (nil) and is not part of operating earnings.

earnings_quality.verdict: Reported P/E is a fair measure: the adjustments found move FY26 PAT by -6.2%, within the 10% threshold. On the FY24-FY26 average, which smooths one-year items, the P/E is 86.6x reported and 91.0x adjusted.
flags: Other income of Rs 35.03 m includes Rs 26.05 m of sundry balances written back on closure of legacy creditors, 5.9% of PBT. It did not recur in FY25 (nil) and is not part of operating earnings.
checked: Provision for expected credit loss Rs 34.90 m charged in FY26 (p. 88); bad debts written off 0.33% of revenue (p. 45)
Interest on vendor credit Rs 7.36 m and bank penal charges Rs 4.39 m are charged to finance cost (p. 474)
Promoter pay of Rs 60.00 m (Jagatjit Singh 30.00, Dharam Singh 18.00, Simran Saron 12.00) is charged in FY26; none in earlier years (p. 94). Pay is 19.1% of PAT and 21.8% of employee cost
Lease of 16.20 acres from the promoter at Rs 1.01 m a year is charged as rent (p. 94); a market rent is not disclosed
Deferred tax is negligible, so cash tax is not flattered (p. 87)
